title: Enhanced User Interface
body:
# Minecraft unOfficial Enhanced UI
This resource pack the UI of Minecraft. It is a part of the [Minecraft unOfficial Proyect](https://modrinth.com/collection/hB55ZXtF).

It's just the culmination of the combination of the old Java GUI, the modern Java GUI, the Bedrock Edition UI. Getting the best of the three worlds, this pack brings the best, simplest (keep in mind that that's the purpose), and detailed GUI pack that have never been conceived in the minds of the Mojang employees.
